title: Life Console
name: life-console
description: Keyboard-first planner that shows what to do right now: time-block your week, count down deadlines and link tasks to goals.

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (required)
env.description: Any long random string, e.g. the output of: openssl rand -hex 32

env.name: APP_URL
env.label: Public address (optional)
env.description: The address people use, e.g. https://planner.example.com. Used for links in emails and secure cookies over https.

note: Set a database password before you deploy (openssl rand -hex 32 makes a good one); the stack won't start without it. Then open http://<your-host>:<Web UI port> (the port you chose above, 8080 by default) and create your account: it becomes the admin. Sign-ups start closed, so nobody else can create an account until you open them in Settings → Sign-ups. Update with Stacks → life-console → Pull and redeploy. Docs: life-console.dev/docs/self-hosting
